title: Hosted Minimal Endpoint Bundle PRD and Launch Tactical Plan
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: Propose a minimal, opinionated bundle of hosted endpoints (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank) offered as a single onboarding product tier for early production customers and internal pilots. Goal is to reduce product surface area for MVP customers while preserving core capabilities: streaming chat, one-shot completions, embedding vectors for search/semantic similarity, and a lightweight rerank primitive. This PRD defines scope, API contracts, SLOs, billing model, rollout plan, and acceptance criteria for a time-boxed launch candidate.

Background: Multiple teams requested a smaller, documented entry product for customers who want high confidence and low configuration overhead. Rather than exposing the full flexible endpoint matrix, this bundle is opinionated about model defaults, latency targets, and caching/batching behavior so we can measure unit economics and reliability across typical web app workloads.

Key decisions proposed in this PRD: 1) Offer 'bundle' as a single product SKU with toggleable sub-endpoints (chat/completion/embedding/rerank) in the same tenant billing bucket. 2) Default model selection per capability (open-model small/medium families) with controlled upgradable options in Dedicated/Private. 3) Streaming support for chat only; completions will support both sync and short-stream modes. 4) Apply automatic prefix caching and 64-token KV prefetch for chat by default. 5) Expose a simple rerank API that accepts up to 10 candidates and returns scores and selected order.

Out-of-scope for this launch: customer-provided models, multi-protocol (grpc) surface, advanced rerank features (pairwise scoring), and enterprise-specific SLAs. These will be tracked as follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: API contracts: chat/completion/embedding/rerank endpoints accepted by SDK team; request/response JSON schemas published in API spec (Confluence link) and validated by SDK integration tests (green).
Performance: mean p50 latency under 120ms for 1-8 token completions, p95 under 400ms for chat turn continuation on canary region under 75% load profile. Metrics must be visible in canary dashboard.

Throughput and cost: hosted minibundle average tokens/unit cost estimate within 15% of target economics (finance-approved cost model). Batching and caching knobs must not regress cost by >10% compared to baseline load tests.
Reliability: availability >= 99.5% during a 2-week canary window and graceful fallback to compatible model variants under capacity pressure. No customer-visible errors for >95% of requests.

Functional: embedding vectors match reference end-to-end vector similarity results within cosine-threshold tolerance (delta <= 0.02) on canonical eval set. Rerank returns stable ordering for canonical dataset and exposes debug scores when debug=true.
Security/Compliance: KMS integration for tenant keys enabled for Private preview customers; audit logs include endpoint, model, and token counts for all requests. Security review sign-off recorded.
Docs & SDK: quickstart guide, example app, and SDK snippets in JS/Python present in docs repo; code samples validated by solutions engineering.
Metrics & Alerts: rollout gating alerts (error rate >1%, latency p95 >600ms, cost-per-token drift >20%) wired to oncall channel and runbook created.
Canary & Rollout: Canary traffic ramp procedure documented; canary must run for minimum 7 days with automated regression checks before 50% traffic ramp.

Complete SDK bindings (js, python) and publish beta packages
Run two full load tests (low and high concurrency) and upload results to dashboard
Finance sign-off on per-token pricing and minibundle SKU
Security review completed and KMS path validated for Private customers
Create support playbook and canned responses for common errors
Instrument tracing and cost attribution at token-level, verify ingestion into observability stack
Create and validate rollback policy with auto-fallback to base model family
Design & Docs: quickstart tutorial, sample app, and API reference ready
Compliance: logging retention settings and audit exports validated
Customer comms: launch email draft and in-product banner copy prepared
Canary plan: schedule canary region and define gating thresholds
